basis_vocabulary.recorded: numeric value given per row in the PSI table
basis_vocabulary.nominal: approximate/nominal value stated in the table
basis_vocabulary.listed_set: table lists several values or a range for the row; per-test assignment not given
basis_vocabulary.assumed_cabin: NOT in the table: nominal ISS/Cygnus cabin air assumed (21% O2, 101.3 kPa)
basis_vocabulary.display_reading: instrument display reading; unit not stated in the table
basis_vocabulary.not_in_table: not available in the PSI experimental table

findings.detail: Ambient pressure recorded as 0 mmHg.
Column headers lost subscripts: 'O initial', 'N initial', 'CO initial' denote O2, N2 and CO2 mole fractions; 'Burning rate; mm' lost its unit (mm^2/s).
Initial CO recorded as a negative value (-1 to -3 ppm) in 13 rows; likely sensor zero offset.

'Air display' and 'Fan display' are instrument readings without a unit in the table. We carry 'Air display' as an air-speed reading (cm/s presumed) flagged as unverified; many cells hold a sequence of settings.
The BASS experimental table lists only date, test, sample and material: oxygen concentration and air flow per test are not provided.

Oxygen is given as % by volume (BASS-II, Saffire, BRE), mole fraction (FLEX, FLEX-2, CFI, CFI-G, Flame Design) or free text (s-Flame). Pressure is given in mmHg (FLEX), atm (Flame Design, FLEX-2, CFI) or bar (CFI-G). Unified here to % O2 by volume and kPa.
